MASTER MOTION CALENDAR ON JUN-29-2011 IN 206, DEFENDANT MICHAEL DVORKIN'S MOTION TO CONTINUE JURY TRIAL AND/OR SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE WAS IMPROPERLY NOTICED. PLAINTIFF PRESENT AND DEFENDANT MICHAEL DVORKIN'S WIFE, SVETLANA DVORKIN, APPEARING FOR DEFENDANT. MRS. DVORKIN REPRESENTED TO THE COURT THAT HER HUSBAND HAS A HEART CONDITION AND COULD NOT APPEAR TODAY. PLAINTIFF WAIVED IMPROPER NOTICE OF DEFENDANT. BASED ON THE PAPERS SUBMITTED, THE COURT DENIED WITHOUT PREJUDICE DEFENDANT'S MOTION TO CONTINUE THE TRIAL. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION FROM THE DEFENDANT'S DOCTOR OR A DECLARATION FROM MR. DVORKIN REGARDING HIS MEDICAL CONDITION AND WHY HE CANNOT PARTICIPATE IN TRIAL MAY BE PROVIDED ON THE DAY OF TRIAL ON 7/5/11 AT 9:00 AM IN DEPT. 206 FOR THE COURT TO RECONSIDER DEFENDANT'S REQUEST FOR A CONTINUANCE.
